description: Golden cases for the built-in keyword list (data/keywords.txt). Every entry is a real shape seen on Chinese X: spam posts that must be caught, and legitimate posts that must not be. A rule change that flips any case fails the suite on purpose — precision is the product, so it may not drift silently. `known_limitation` cases are recorded flips we accept, and are counted separately so they cannot hide a regression.

cases.text: 真实线下 点我主页 进群选人
cases.note: Three spam phrases stacked, the classic bot template.

cases.text: 哥哥宝藏 添加主页微信 自取资源
有没有单男 附近约p 全天可约
学生求哥哥照顾 处男免费 线下直接对接
不分早晚 昼夜不拒 晨昏不拒 寻欢必备
cases.note: Spintax filler lines that only exist to defeat exact matching.

cases.text: 我好奇去快手搜了一下还真的是他 快手的一个网黄
cases.note: Teaser toward an off-platform adult account.

cases.text: 整理了大赛合集 完整的存好 合集视频来了
AI女友在线成人角色扮演 零注册零下载
没她好看 比她骚 就她的主页能打
cases.note: Comparison bait that funnels to a profile.

cases.text: sao货 玩的就是反差
进群选人 dd个线下的
这条广告说“进群选人 点我主页”，看到就举报，别点。
cases.note: Quoting spam to report it matches the quoted phrase. Fixing this needs quote-context detection (the surrounding sentence says 广告/举报/别点), which the matcher deliberately does not do today.

cases.text: This scam DM literally says 真实线下 点我主页 — report it.
cases.note: Same as clean-quoting-spam: an English sentence quoting Chinese spam still matches the phrase.

cases.text: 最近评论区全是机器人，关键词过滤把“真实线下”“点我主页”这类都拦掉了。
cases.note: Talking *about* the spam phrases trips them. Needs the same quote-context signal.

cases.text: 我是一个产品经理，喜欢摄影和长跑，周末常去爬山。
今天自拍了一张，光线不错。
cases.note: Over-matched before the list was trimmed; short everyday words must stay clean.

cases.text: 这家店的丝袜质量还可以，价格也公道。
他老婆人妻感很强，演得挺好。
这个政策对小微企业的影响还需要观察。
const result = await fetch(url).then((r) => r.json());
比特币今天又跌了，市场情绪很差。
cases.note: Topic words are deliberately left to the opt-in community lists.

cases.text: 公司内网要用 VPN 才能连上。
这台二手相机 3200 出，成色九成新。
订单号 1234567890 麻烦帮我查一下物流。
他做事一向不分早晚，随时都在回消息。
cases.note: “不分早晚” is ordinary speech in a longer sentence, but it is also a spintax filler line in the list. Short filler phrases carry this risk by construction.

cases.text: 警方通报：某平台因涉黄被处罚，相关账号已封禁。
用了三个月，续航比宣传的差一点，其他都还行。
昨晚那场球真心精彩，最后三分钟翻盘。
招前端一名，三年以上经验，远程可谈。
性教育读物推荐：这本适合初中生家长一起读。
cases.note: Talking about sex education is not solicitation.

cases.text: 看一下这个号：真实线下 点我主页 进群选人 附近约p 全天可约 找我
cases.note: A quote that reproduces the whole template is still spam-shaped; catching it is the right call.

cases.text: 我在主页放了个链接，有兴趣可以看看。
cases.note: “主页” alone is legitimate: only the longer spam phrases are in the list.
